scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check services ml/eval ml/corpus ml/train && uv run ruff format --check services ml/eval ml/corpus ml/train
scripts.typecheck:py: cd services/veritas && uv run mypy && cd ../indexa && uv run mypy
scripts.test:py: uv run pytest services/veritas && uv run pytest services/indexa && cd ml/eval && uv run --no-sync pytest -q && cd ../corpus && uv run --no-sync pytest -q && cd ../train && uv run --no-sync pytest -q
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm lint:py && pnpm typecheck:py && pnpm test:py
scripts.contracts:generate: tsx scripts/export-contracts.ts && prettier --write --log-level warn packages/core/schemas && uv run --no-sync ruff format services/indexa/src/indexa/contracts.py services/veritas/src/veritas/contracts.py
scripts.contracts:check: pnpm contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/core/schemas services/indexa/src/indexa/contracts.py services/veritas/src/veritas/contracts.py && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard packages/core/schemas services/veritas/src/veritas/contracts.py)"
scripts.benchmark:plagiarism: cd ml/eval && uv run --no-sync python -m plagiarism.benchmark
